text: Current Linux and Windows CSS reserve icon space for uniconed menu and menuitem nodes in extension popups, while macOS explicitly shows the icon and suppresses its extra pseudo-element. These platform rules have distinct target states; copying only a selector or only the padding value can change alignment. A scoped manual CSS recommendation is to check menu and menuitem coverage plus checked/icon-bearing state when altering this family. No platform rendering or keyboard inspection ran. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Keep extension icon layout rules scoped to their actual menu node types
